name: Mateo Vargas
bio:
Mateo Vargas's journey into motorsport began with a childhood fascination for Formula 1 races broadcast from Europe. He spent countless hours tinkering with go-karts and dreaming of a career in racing. After earning a degree in Mechanical Engineering from Universidad Nacional de Colombia, Mateo started his career as a junior engineer for a local racing team. His meticulous attention to detail and ability to quickly adapt to changing circumstances led to a rapid ascent through the ranks. 

As Sporting Director, Mateo believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels valued and empowered. He's known for his calm demeanor under pressure, a trait that has proven invaluable during high-stakes races. Mateo is particularly passionate about data analysis and using it to optimize race strategies, always seeking innovative ways to gain a competitive edge. His loyalty to Walkinshaw Andretti United is unwavering, and he sees the team as an extension of his own family.

physical.hairStyle: short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a lean build and a focused expression.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook to jot down observations and ideas.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
Insists on having a cup of strong Colombian coffee before every race.
